name: SkylarkAds Advertisement Banner
author: skylarkads

sections.description:
SkylarkAds is a comprehensive advertisement management system for WordPress that allows you to create stunning ad banners with customizable designs, track views and clicks with detailed analytics, schedule campaigns, and optimize ad performance – all from your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features

  • Visual Banner Editor – Create beautiful ad banners with an intuitive visual editor
  • Responsive Design – Banners automatically adapt to mobile and desktop devices
  • Analytics & Tracking – Detailed view and click tracking with comprehensive reports
  • Campaign Management – Schedule and manage advertising campaigns
  • Google Analytics Integration – Seamless integration with Google Analytics
  • Customizable Designs – Full control over colors, fonts, and layouts
  • Performance Optimization – Lightweight and fast-loading banners

Premium Features

Upgrade to SkylarkAds Premium for advanced features:

  • Advanced Analytics – Enhanced reporting and insights
  • WYSIWYG Editor – Rich text editor for banner content
  • Font Library – Access to premium fonts
  • Visual Customization – Advanced styling options
  • Campaign Automation – Automated campaign management

External services

This plugin connects to several external services to provide analytics tracking, advertisement serving, and premium functionality. Below is detailed information about each service, what data is sent, and when.

Google Analytics

This plugin loads Google Analytics tracking on your website when a Google Analytics tracking ID is configured in the plugin settings. It tracks page views across your entire website and also sends specific banner interaction data.

What data is sent: Page view data for all pages on your website, user session information, and standard Google Analytics data. Additionally, banner-specific events including banner IDs, campaign IDs, view and click counts are sent both via the Measurement Protocol (server-side) and gtag events (client-side).

When data is sent: Page view tracking occurs on every page load across your entire website when a Google Analytics tracking ID is configured in the plugin settings. Banner-specific events are sent both server-side and client-side when users view or click on banners.

Service provider: Google LLC
Terms of Service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Tag Manager

This plugin uses Google Tag Manager’s gtag.js library to load and configure Google Analytics tracking across your website.

What data is sent: Page view data for all pages on your website, user session information, and standard Google Analytics tracking data as configured in your Google Analytics property. Additionally, banner-specific events are sent via gtag when users interact with banners.

When data is sent: On every page load across your entire website when Google Analytics tracking ID is configured in the plugin settings. Banner events are sent in real-time when users view or click banners.

Service provider: Google LLC
Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/analytics/terms/tag-manager/
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google AdSense

This plugin loads the Google AdSense script to enable AdSense functionality on your website. The script makes AdSense ad serving capabilities available but does not automatically display ads within banners.

What data is sent: Standard AdSense data including user browsing context, page information, and publisher configuration for ad targeting and serving (when AdSense ads are actually displayed on your site). Additionally, banner interaction events are logged locally and sent via dataLayer for correlation with AdSense performance.

When data is sent: When AdSense Publisher ID is configured in settings and the AdSense script is loaded on pages. Data transmission occurs when AdSense ads are displayed. Banner events are sent to dataLayer when users interact with banners.

Service provider: Google LLC
Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/adsense/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Matomo Analytics (Optional)

This plugin optionally supports Matomo analytics as an alternative to Google Analytics. It’s used for users who prefer self-hosted analytics solutions.

What data is sent: Banner view and click data, campaign information, user interaction metrics, and page URLs (sent to your configured Matomo server). Banner events are sent both server-side via HTTP requests and client-side via the Matomo JavaScript tracker.

When data is sent: Only when Matomo is manually configured by the user in plugin settings and analytics tracking is enabled. Banner events are sent in real-time when users interact with banners.

Service provider: Your own Matomo installation or Matomo Cloud
Terms of Service: Depends on your Matomo hosting provider
Privacy Policy: Depends on your Matomo hosting provider

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/skylarkads-wp-plugin directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the SkylarkAds menu in your WordPress admin to configure the plugin
  4. Create your first ad banner and start tracking performance
sections.faq:
How do I create my first ad banner?

After activating the plugin, go to the SkylarkAds menu in your WordPress admin. Click “Add New Banner” and use the visual editor to create your banner.

Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, SkylarkAds is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme.

Can I track banner performance?

Yes, the plugin includes comprehensive analytics to track views, clicks, and performance metrics.

Is there a premium version?

Yes, SkylarkAds Premium offers advanced features like enhanced analytics, WYSIWYG editor, and premium fonts.
sections.changelog:
1.6.9

  • Fixed unwanted background styling on h3 title elements in banner previews
  • Removed excessive debug logging for cleaner console output in production
  • Enhanced CSS specificity to override WordPress core styles and theme conflicts
  • Improved error handling with more targeted logging approach
  • Added comprehensive background removal for title elements

1.6.8

  • Optimized console output by removing debug logs for optional field detection
  • Eliminated mobile position debug logs and fallback dimension logs
  • Enhanced defensive programming patterns for missing form fields
  • Improved performance by reducing console operations

1.6.7

  • Enhanced getElementValue function with comprehensive error handling
  • Added intelligent field detection for required vs optional fields
  • Implemented graceful fallbacks for missing image dimension fields
  • Maintained backward compatibility while improving error resilience

1.6.6

  • Enhanced analytics integration – banner events now sent to all configured analytics services
  • Added client-side tracking for Google Analytics/GTM, Matomo, and AdSense
  • Improved banner view and click tracking with real-time event transmission
  • Added AdSense event correlation logging for performance analysis
  • Updated external services documentation for enhanced tracking capabilities

1.6.2

  • Fixed WordPress coding standards compliance
  • Added proper plugin headers and licensing
  • Improved security with output escaping
  • Enhanced internationalization support

1.6.1

  • Bug fixes and performance improvements
  • Enhanced security features
  • Updated analytics tracking

1.6.0

  • Initial public release
  • Visual banner editor
  • Basic analytics tracking
  • Campaign management features
